notes: Helpers can now do real work: the AI can hand a separate job to a "general" helper that edits files and runs commands. It goes through the same permission questions, folder checks and Undo as the AI itself, and its steps show in the chat.

New helper types like Claude Code: explore (looks only), plan (looks and writes a plan) and general. Your own helpers from .claude/agents files (the same format Claude Code uses) work too, with their own tools, model and instructions.
Helpers can run in the background while the AI carries on; their report arrives by itself, and the reply waits for them before it ends. Stop stops them too.
